FAKE NEWS:  How many “Nazi dictators” give interviews to media outlets that slam and smear them 24/7?

Video

It’s a pattern.  A core group on Left justifies crime with noble intentions.  Stealing described as social justice-style “micro-looting,” statue desecration as “history correction,” and assassination as “democratic intervention.”  Media let it slide for too long.

Piker’s in vogue because he’s edgy, young and will say defiantly what many older Dems are thinking.


End Wokeness (@EndWokeness)

Hasan Piker: "KiII the motherf*ckers. Let the streets soak in their red, capitalist bIood!"

3 days ago, the NYT promoted him

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/EndWokeness/status/2048217117221065201#m

At this moment, Donald Trump is the only thing standing between America and socialism. That’s why the hard Left wants him gone by any means necessary, and why they’ve bred and fed countless “recruits” to answer their twisted call.
“Where’s Marco? Where’s Marco?” demands Rep. Seth Moulton regarding Iran negotiations, of course in his familiar sneering tone.

Give it a rest, David.  Focus on rooting out the assassination culture and anti-American bile in your own once great party.


David Axelrod (@davidaxelrod)

Here's the official statement announcing plans for a grand new White House ballroom last July. Not one word about the need for it due to security.
Last night, the @POTUS & his acolytes immediately seized on the WHCA attack at to justify his dream project. whitehouse.gov/briefings-sta…




— https://nitter.net/davidaxelrod/status/20484130
The president is absolutely correct. He’s targeted because he’s effective and transformational. If he sat back in the office and didn’t try to do big things, he’d probably be a lot safer.

We don’t believe anything you say. Your vilifying of the president (warning of a “path to dictatorship”) helped foster this dangerous, sick environment.


Chuck Schumer (@SenSchumer)

I am closely monitoring the unfolding situation at the White House Correspondents Dinner. I’m grateful for the quick response of law enforcement and am praying everyone remains safe.



— https://nitter.net/SenSchumer/status/2048207206609297745#m
Remember that the Washington Hilton, the site of the WHCD, is where Reagan was shot in 1981.

BREAKING NEWS: Shooting at the WHCD. How does this keep happening?

Video
Think about it:  POTUS, VPOTUS, Speaker of the House, Rubio and Bessent were all there at WHCD.  Risky in this insane world.  President Grassley?
How does this keep happening?   Send everyone home.  Trump should address the nation tonight or tomorrow night.
Laura: Democrats Won’t Admit Trump Made America Safer
Rep. Chip Roy: “Iran’s radical theocracy has held the world HOSTAGE.”
Mike Sarraille: “Iran is using the Strait of Hormuz as a pressure LEVER.”

Dan Bongino: “Lone actors worry me more than sleeper cells.”
